description: Jupyter notebook for visualization of spatially distributed data in risk and resilience analysis is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jamie Padgett, Rice University (rice.edu). This project serves as the main repository for the Jupyter Notebook and complimentary input data required for the DesignSafe use case noted as “Jupyter notebooks for visualization of spatially distributed data in risk and resilience analysis”. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-a74m-g031. Keywords: visualization tools, static maps and figures, interactive maps and figures, animated maps and figures, spatially distributed data, infrastructure systems. Published 2023-09-26. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GPL-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
